scenes.title: An Interview with the Competitor
scenes.summary: Feeling unappreciated at Claude Monet, Max secretly interviews with Elena Sokolova, the head chef of rival restaurant Arcobaleno.

scenes.title: Encounter of the Competitors
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor Barinov bumps into Elena Sokolova on the street and mocks her hiring ads, while Elena hints that Claude Monet cooks are applying to work for her.

scenes.title: Asleep on the Shift
scenes.summary: During a high-pressure dinner rush at Claude Monet, Chef Barinov discovers Max sound asleep on vegetable crates in the storage room.

scenes.title: A Sweet Dream
scenes.summary: Max falls asleep in the dining room and has an affectionate dream about Chef Viktor Barinov, who furiously wakes him up.

scenes.title: Staff Lunch
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor Barinov assigns Max to cook lunch for the staff, warning him of dire consequences if the food is not good.

scenes.title: The Chef's Wrath
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov discovers rival restaurant Arcobaleno attempting to recruit his kitchen staff and fiercely interrogates his team.

scenes.title: Kostya Is in Love
scenes.summary: Max notices Kostya staring at Nastya and encourages the nervous bartender to give her a compliment.

scenes.title: Ingredients for Soup
scenes.summary: Senya hands Max the fresh vegetables and cream for the soup and reviews proper prep technique.

scenes.title: Get to Work
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov inspects Max at the soup station and commands him to begin cooking immediately.

scenes.title: The Lie Detector
scenes.summary: Barinov and a polygraph expert hook up fish cook Fedya to a lie detector to find out if he secretly interviewed at the rival restaurant Arcobaleno.

scenes.title: Girls Like a Guy with Guts
scenes.summary: Watching Vika from across the dining hall, Max hesitates to approach her until bartender Kostya urges him to show courage and take the initiative.

scenes.title: A Full Confession
scenes.summary: Terrified of the lie detector chair, Senya panics and confesses to every scrap of banquet meat and fish he ever pilfered from the kitchen.

scenes.title: Order at the Bar
scenes.summary: Waitress Nastya places a large drinks order with bartender Kostya, who gets distracted and nervously asks her to repeat the drink amounts.

scenes.title: The Curly Hairstyle
scenes.summary: Kostya tries to give Nastya an awkward compliment about her curly hair by comparing her to a fluffy lamb, but she takes offense and insults him back.

scenes.title: Staff Lunch
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov interrogates Max on whether staff lunch is ready, catching him in a lie, while Max frantically claims the chef is like a father to him.

scenes.title: A Friend's Request
scenes.summary: Behind the bar, Kostya fails to ask Nastya out on a date and begs Max to speak with her on his behalf.

scenes.title: A Cosmic Connection
scenes.summary: Max attempts to explain Kostya's feelings to Nastya, but she mistakes his clumsy speech for a romantic confession of his own.

scenes.title: Chef Against Chef
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov confronts rival chef Elena Pavlovna at Arcobaleno to find out which of his cooks applied for a job there.

scenes.title: Staff Lunch
scenes.summary: In the Claude Monet kitchen, line cook Senya impatiently asks Max when the staff will eat, while Max promises a gourmet purée soup.

scenes.title: The Blue Soup
scenes.summary: Max serves a bizarre bright blue soup to the kitchen staff; pastry chef Louis realizes his food coloring was used, but the staff finds the dish surprisingly tasty.

scenes.title: Two Minutes
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor Barinov furiously confronts Max over the ruined colored soup and gives him two minutes to pack his things and get out.

scenes.title: Conversation in the Office
scenes.summary: Vika enters Barinov's office to defend Max, admitting she was the one who went to the rival restaurant and urging the chef not to ruin a promising talent.

scenes.title: Max's Dismissal
scenes.summary: After Chef Barinov vents in his office, Max packs up his belongings in the locker room while Nastya offers him heartfelt comfort.

scenes.title: A Chance to Stay
scenes.summary: Vika runs outside to stop Max from leaving, revealing he is not fired and giving him a second chance to prove his culinary worth.
